exposure.needed: whether any dashboards, alerts or scrapers reference the metric lbipam_conflicting_pools_total

original.statement: The metric lbipam_conflicting_pools_total has been renamed to lbipam_conflicting_pools.

decision.reason: [ev-2e2ab2d37845] says only that the metric `lbipam_conflicting_pools_total` was renamed to `lbipam_conflicting_pools`. The only environments affected are those whose monitoring (dashboards, alerts, recording rules, scrapers) queries the old metric name. That monitoring setup sits outside the product's Helm values and manifests, so no static predicate can detect it. An undecidable exposure with an environment-visibility gap and that "needed" description fits the evidence, and nothing in the evidence supports a narrower static condition.
